non_minimal_changes: D7 turns the whole deontic vocabulary (PERMITTED, AUTHORIZED, ELIGIBLE, DELEGATED, 'remains' rule) into a closed lexicon; G5 needed only REQUIRED/PROHIBITED/STATUS_CONSTRAINT. Side effect: 'no ... may' (R01) is not listed as PROHIBITED
R-X1 restricts section use for all acts and norms, not only R-A3 performatives and the G5 operator question
R-A5 codifies all act states, incl. a new UNKNOWN rule for ACT_REVERSED (A1) and A5; G3 needed only REFUSED vs OCCURRED, G4 only A4
D11 STATED/MENTIONED applies to all norms, incl. those cited as evidence or grounds in session logs and commits; G2 needed it only for matrix rows
D8(ii) generalises R-A1's single example to every present/future indicative about an operation
R-S1 counting clause prescribes analysis rather than coding (minor; G6-related)
neutrality_issues: BLOCKING N1 (R-A3 scope): self-performed refusals/withdrawals/reversals of ANY operation in ANY section are acts (D3 last bullet; A1-A3 before A7), while positive self-performance is limited to five ops in register rows. E.g. R-36 'Expressly NOT promoted' -> ACT_REFUSED promote, but 'Promoted into AST-013' -> NONE. This is TC-1 alternative 1c applied only to negatives: undisclosed, labelled SELF_PERFORMED (defined in D3 as R-A3 (a)-(c)), and contradicting R-A3's 'any other operation -> NONE'

N2 (governed-act level): D12 lists 'remains candidate'/'stays in ...' as INELIGIBLE verdicts, and VERDICT > STATUS_PREDICATE lifts literal status labels on the behaviour (R19-R21) to the meta-act promote. This contradicts R-N1's no-re-levelling rule and RATIONALE's rejected 'always meta-act'. Small H-D/H-B effect; status label lost from coded fields
N3: R-N3 codes the authorize performative as OPERATOR, so bare 'X AUTHORIZED' norms are definitionally paired with their act but cannot be excluded under TC-4 4b

N4: D8(ii) turns descriptive/predictive indicatives into norms (R27 'APPLIES §12'; R-47 'no observable behaviour changes until 7C'; R-77 'Implementation continues under ...'), inflating norms on work (toward H-B coupling); unlisted theory choice
N5: D11 'cites as evidence' / 'asserts as its own' can drop every norm reported in session logs or commits, leaving norms only in governance instruments (toward H-D); unlisted

N6: the REPORTED vs SELF_PERFORMED boundary is undefined for register rows that reproduce another actor's ruling or instruction (R02 'RULING AS ISSUED, VERBATIM'; R23 '(Principal Architect instruction)'); it decides survival under TC-1 1b
theory_choices_assessment: TC-1: correctly listed as inherited; incomplete: omits self-performed negative dispositions (B1), so the 1a/1c descriptions are inaccurate
TC-2: correctly a theory choice; 2b underspecified (no link field to the adopting act beyond parsing the section heading; inferred deontic value open)
TC-3: appropriate; r3 codes no force, so this is an analysis-time choice and listing it is harmless
TC-4: appropriate; incomplete for bare authorize performatives coded OPERATOR (N3)
Missing from THEORY-CHOICES: self-performed refusals/withdrawals as acts; D8(ii) prospective indicatives as norms; D11 treatment of reported/cited norms
Acceptably decided: 'standard/permanent/binding' never REQUIRED (lexical, recoverable from 'status: <label>')
Over-listed: none; no listed choice could have been decided neutrally in the schema
conflicts: R-A3 G1 bullet ('self-performs any other operation -> NONE') vs D3 last bullet and A1-A3 (self-performed refusals/withdrawals of any operation are acts)
D3 circular/self-contradicting: R-A3(c) requires SELF_PERFORMED (D3); D3 defines it as 'R-A3 (a)-(c) hold', then also assigns it to refusals failing (a)/(b)
D11 (cited grounds are MENTIONED) vs R-N1 example 'forbids promoting from one' (R22 ground clause) vs D8(i) 'the register holds X' (R06/R07 ground clause)
D12 negative-verdict phrases vs D8(i) status labels and R-N1 no-re-levelling; only priority decides
R-A1 (retained) 'not ACT_REFUSED unless an attempt is recorded' vs A3/R-A2 accepting a proposal
D4 (issued PREPARED ruling = proposal) vs D6 (a proposal is not ATTEMPTED); consistent only if the proposal (adopt) and attempt (instrument's op) are different operations, which is unstated
R-A5 merge rule ('coded as X') vs R-A3 closed list: an adoption whose content is promotion (R-36) can be recoded promote -> A7 NONE

Priority incomplete: NORM has no tie rule for same-class clauses on one target (R12 MAY/MUST NOT; R34 AUTHORIZED + may begin RED) or unclear target splits; step 7 UNKNOWN contradicts R-A4 ('span does not decide'). ACT state order is complete, but operation selection has no same-step tie-break and 'highest step' is undefined
blocking: B1: R-A3 scope leak for negative dispositions. Self-performed refusals/withdrawals/reversals of any operation in any section are coded as acts under R-A3's own SELF_PERFORMED label, contradicting R-A3's closed scope and not disclosed in TC-1. This builds the flagged H-D-favouring text-as-act convention into default observations asymmetrically (non-promotions are acts, promotions are not). Fix: separate basis value (e.g. SELF_PERFORMED_DISPOSITION), apply the R-A3 scope test or default NONE, and list in TC-1

B2: G3 not closed on R01. Section 3 lets a PROPOSAL be an INFERENCE, which reopens coder judgement inside R-A2/A2/A3, and the merge rule leaves X (resolve vs adopt) open. Fix: require a stated (SOURCE_FACT) proposal, else UNKNOWN; fix X as the refusal verb's complement
nonblocking: Add a NORM tie rule for same-class clauses and multi-target spans (R12, R34) instead of sending them to UNKNOWN
Resolve D11 vs R-N1: state whether norms cited as grounds or reported from another actor are STATED (decides R06/R07, R22)
Restrict D12's negative-verdict list or keep 'status: <label>' for status labels in review sections (N2)
Tag bare authorize performatives so TC-4 4b can exclude them (N3)
Narrow D8(ii) to statements that assign a standing; list the broader reading as a theory choice (N4)
Fix the D3 / R-A3(c) circularity; add an R-A5 same-step operation tie-break and define 'highest step'
Clarify the D4/D6 split; reconcile R-A1 'attempt' with R-A2/A3 'proposal or attempt'
Define REPORTED vs SELF_PERFORMED for rows reproducing another actor's ruling or instruction (R02, R23)
Generalise D7 negation handling ('no ... may'), so R01's norm is not PERMITTED by literal match
Give D13 a rule for spans naming two operations (R30 'ANNOTATE is adopted'; R05 'PLAN AND IMPLEMENT')
Disclose the non-minimal extensions (D7, R-X1, A1/A5, D11, D8(ii)) as scope extensions
